pieces.Text: A demon lord can activate his frightful presence as a free action.
A demon lord grants spells to its followers and has a favored weapon as if it were a deity.
A demon lord's natural weapons, as well as any weapons it wields, are treated as chaotic, epic, and evil for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.
Only epic and good damage, or damage from a creature of equal or greater power interrupts a demon lord's regeneration.
Three times per day, a demon lord can summon any demon or combination of demons whose total combined CR is 20 or lower.
A demon lord who is slain can be instantly ressurected in his home realm once each year.
